comparison.objective: Seat a tablet in a V-cradle and split it by closing a blade; candidate fractures four insert tangs and recovers them.
comparison.physical_skill: Cradle seating and quasi-static hinged-blade closure versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, separate-hammer impact, lateral-force control, and tiny-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Tablet seated and split versus four manufactured-notch fractures, all four fragments contained, and retained coils/shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Both involve fracture, but the central tested mechanisms and post-fracture outcomes differ materially. The tablet record has no body/specs, so fragment, force, and damage rules are unspecified.
